additional_info.subject: ID0471370-DC/Si-D/AT- [Y2/SN313981068001] Multiple Errors Including Cable Theft CRM:03289000188
additional_info.body:
Dear
Lara,
Following your report and after our checks, we can confirm that the two outlets are available for use and are not affected.
Regarding the warning indicating that the cables are theft, this is related to the two cable sensors, which are responsible for generating this incorrect warning message.
We will continue to monitor the charger, and if this error appears again, we will take the necessary actions and dispatch a technician to check the sensors and resolve the issue.
With best regards,
Younes Baroudi
eMobility Technical Support Team
